title: Outsiders Lot of 19 DC Comics 2003-2005 #3-14 16-21 + 1-2 Double Feature Winick
condition_description: All 19 covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. Front of every issue pictured. See photos.
description:
Outsiders (DC Comics, 2003 series) - a 19-issue run from Judd Winick's relaunch of the team: Nightwing, Arsenal, Metamorpho, Grace, Thunder, Indigo and Jade.

You get:
- Outsiders Double Feature (collects Outsiders #1 and #2 in one book)
- #3 through #14 (Oct 2003 - Sep 2004), incl. #3 Joker/Lex Luthor cover, #8 Huntress, #10 Shazam, #13 return of the Fearsome Five
- #16 through #21 (Nov 2004 - Apr 2005), incl. #17-18 guest-starring John Walsh and #21 Batman vs Nightwing "Divided"

NOT included: #15 (missing from the run).

Art by Tom Raney, Scott Hanna, ChrisCross, Carlos D'Anda and others. $2.50 cover price.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a box.
notes: Photos in photos/outsiders-2003-run/. #10 comes from live single 880038732832, which ends when this lot goes up. Owner may cancel if #15 turns up.
